# FDG3067

> DO NOT have properties that match the name of “Get” methods, such as a property named `TextWriter` and a method named `GetTextWriter`.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.6.2 Names of Properties.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1721
- Automatic fix: not applied automatically (the fix can break callers)
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Renaming the property or the Get method changes the public API, so the fix is breaking; CA1721 has no code fix.

## From the book

```csharp
public string TextWriter { get {...} set {...} }
public string GetTextWriter(int value) { ... }
```

This pattern typically indicates that the property should really be a method. See section 5.1.3 for additional information.
